purpose: Conditional learning-seed variability with geometry, hardware, task type, battery and outage masks fixed.
selection: First maximum mean lifetime on validation seeds 1000000..1000004; no test-based selection.
scope: One fixed development layout; not a multi-layout generalization study or full paper reproduction.
notes: Layout0 is the first layout in the completed reference protocol, reused to avoid another full-budget seed0 run; its outcomes were already observed, so this is a developmental diagnostic.
Learning seed changes initialization, exploration, minibatches and training task-seed sequence. This does not isolate initialization alone.
Run the three heuristics once per test case; do not replicate them into independent learning-seed samples.
Reuse the completed seed0 checkpoint without retraining or modifying its source artifacts; verify its provenance and physics/hyperparameters first.
Test task seeds were used previously in development; not a sealed final-test set.
No convention is chosen to match the publication score. Reference conventions remain unchanged.
Best and final checkpoint evaluations share the same cases and are not independent replications.
